title: Anyone here using bezi ai (for unity)?
author: HereToLearn321
selftext: And why do you prefer it to say codex/claude ? And have you tried Opus 5.5 / Astra?etc?

comments.author: Melodic-Chemistry127
comments.body: I have tried it and prefer normal harnesses. I haven't found anything that Bezi can do but my harness can't. I'm probably stupid, but what can it do that Claude Code + good MCP + Obsidian can't do?

replies.author: HereToLearn321
replies.body: just curious if you are using Obsidian  as your scratchpad or project plannign kinda like bezi seem to have. i was using notion before but hadnt thought about hooking it up to the ai.

comments.author: NinjaMidget76
comments.body: I use it occasionally, their Proofs section is pretty cool and their unity integration was the best you could find, prior to Unity launching their own plug-ins for harnesses natively. I still use it for building VFX that I can see in their app ahead of time prior to rendering it in unity. I can see Unity eventually getting it right and replacing most of the unique features, but that also depends on Unity not doing an ADHD roadmap like they have in the past.

replies.author: HereToLearn321
replies.body: could you explain more about their proofs. i just a quick vide on bezi and proofs and planning mode were mentioned but i didn't really get what proofs do. so i'll ahve to try to find a better video
